    Weight-homogeneous lifts of module actions (toward Proposition 12.8) #

    deformation-refinements.tex: the degree-by-degree lifting of Proposition 6.5 with the choices "made separately in each degree and weight". If the deformation μ_q and the action of M have all relative weights in a monoid C (ConeBil), the corrections can be taken with relative weights in C: the error of the next degree has weights in C, and the cone part of any correction removing it removes it as well, since the correction equation commutes with the cone parts (cbil). Hence a lifted action with all relative weights in C (exists_actFam_cone).
